violations.description: EMPLOYEE HYGIENE (5 pts): Employee noted handling food contact items with contaminated hands. Observed employees not washing hands after touching hair face items that were picked up off of floor etc.

CONTAMINATION BY EMPLOYEES (3 pts): Bare hand contact with ready to eat food noted not being avoided. Observed employee portioning out french fries using a scoop but the excess french fries from the container cascaded down the back of the hand and wrist of employee and then fell back into the hot holding bin. Bare hand contact occured when loading the french fries into the to-go bags by grasping the container of fries from the top of which the palm of the hand comes in contact with the ready to eat fries.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Equipment exteriors noted not clean. Observed dark build up on underside of leftside customer soda dispenser.
EMPLOYEE HYGIENE (5 pts): Kitchen employees noted washing hands in restroom sinks to continue with food handling. This practice was initiated due to the main hand wash lavatory faucet not working.
HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): The hand washing lavatory automatic faucet was not function at the time of inspection batteries were dead.

EMPLOYEE HYGIENE (5 pts): Employee noted handling food while hands were contaminated and did not wash hands before starting work. Observed employees touching aprons pickinig up trash from floor and handling cell phone before regloving and handling food.

CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted being stored not covered in food dispensing. Observed ice tea dispenser lids in customer beverage station and in the drive thru beverage area not tight fitting.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Pop nozzles and surrounding area not properly maintained.

FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floors in the establishment noted in need of cleaning. Floors under ice cream equipment in customer dining area and in walk-in-freezer and coolers need more through cleaning. Observed heavy debris build up.
SINGLE - USE/SINGLE - SERVICE ARTICLES (1 pts): Cups noted being stored on the floor in the dry goods storage area.
